content: Nutraceuticals: Definitions of Functional Foods, Nutraceuticals and

problems and diseases that can be prevented or cured by
Nutraceuticals i.e., weight control, diabetes, cancer, heart disease

features (chemical nature medicinal benefits) of following a)
Carotenoids- a and ß-Carotene, Lycopene, Xanthophylls, leutin b)
Sulfides: Diallyl sulfides, Allyl trisulfide. c) Polyphenolics:
Reservetrol d) Flavonoids- Rutin, Naringin, Quercetin
Anthocyanidins, catechins, Flavones e) Prebiotics / Probiotics:
Fructo-oligosaccharides, Lactobacillus f) Phytoestrogens:
Isoflavones, daidzein, Geebustin, lignans g) Tocopherols h)
Proteins, vitamins, minerals, cereal, vegetables and beverages as
functional foods: oats, wheat bran, rice bran, seafood, coffee, tea
and the like

prevention

FSSAI, FDA, FPO, MPO
AGMARK. HACCP and GMPs on Food Safety. Adulteration of
foods. c) Pharmacopeial Specifications for dietary supplements and
